summary: FinVolution Group filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 unaudited results and announcing a new share repurchase program of up to US$150 million. The buyback is authorized by the board with no specific expiration or price/share stated. The program is a capital return to shareholders, funded by the issuer's own cash. No other special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist, etc.) is present. The filing is routine financial-reporting plus a standing buyback. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on shares outstanding.
